nodes.label: RAGAs (Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment)
nodes.description: A framework for reference-free evaluation of RAG pipelines, providing automated metrics for retrieval quality, generation faithfulness, and overall answer quality.

nodes.label: What is RAGAs?
nodes.description: Definition and core innovation of the RAGAs framework.

nodes.label: Full Form
nodes.description: Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment.

nodes.label: Purpose
nodes.description: To systematically evaluate RAG systems, which combine a retriever and a generator.

nodes.label: Key Innovation
nodes.description: Does not rely on human-annotated reference answers; uses automated metrics for performance judgment.

nodes.label: Why RAG Evaluation is Challenging
nodes.description: Challenges arise from the combined nature of RAG systems and the multiple aspects needing evaluation.

nodes.label: RAG System Components
nodes.description: RAG systems combine two main components.

nodes.label: Retriever
nodes.description: Finds relevant context passages.

nodes.label: Generator (LLM)
nodes.description: Produces answers using the retrieved context.

nodes.label: Evaluation Considerations
nodes.description: Multiple factors must be considered during RAG evaluation.

nodes.label: Retrieval Relevance
nodes.description: Assessing if the retriever fetched the correct documents.

nodes.label: Faithful Usage
nodes.description: Checking if the LLM correctly used the retrieved context.

nodes.label: Answer Quality
nodes.description: Evaluating if the final response is coherent, accurate, and useful.

nodes.label: How RAGAs Works
nodes.description: RAGAs introduces a suite of metrics to cover various evaluation dimensions.

nodes.label: Suite of Metrics
nodes.description: Metrics covering multiple dimensions of RAG performance.

nodes.label: Context Relevance
nodes.description: Measures how well retrieved passages match the query.

nodes.label: Answer Faithfulness
nodes.description: Checks if the generated answer is grounded in the retrieved context.

nodes.label: Answer Quality
nodes.description: Evaluates fluency, coherence, and informativeness of the answer.

nodes.label: Reference-Free Evaluation
nodes.description: Eliminates the need for gold-standard answers, enabling faster and more scalable testing.

nodes.label: Benefits of RAGAs
nodes.description: Advantages of using the RAGAs framework for evaluation.

nodes.label: Faster Evaluation Cycles
nodes.description: Critical for rapid experimentation in RAG pipelines.

nodes.label: Scalable Testing
nodes.description: Avoids costly human annotation, making evaluation more efficient.

nodes.label: Holistic Assessment
nodes.description: Covers retrieval, grounding, and generation quality comprehensively.

nodes.label: Supports LLM Adoption
nodes.description: Especially important for enterprises deploying RAG in various applications like customer support, research, and domain-specific Q&A.
